verses.text: Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tas ix alchaj chi', ix snik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal, ix yak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal winh, ix yak'ank'e k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh winh t'a sjolom, ix och ijan winh yek' t'a kal chonhab'. Tz'el yaw winh yuj kusk'olal.
Haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a sti' spalacio winh rey, maj ochlaj winh t'a yo'ol, yujto max chaji'ochlaj junok mach yuj winh rey chi' tato ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj.

Hanhejtona' t'a masanil chonhab' b'ajtak ix tz'ib'chajb'at jun ley chi', masanil heb' israel ix och t'a kusk'olal. Ayik ix sch'oxanel skusk'olal heb' chi', ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tz'ok' heb', tz'el yaw heb', tzijtum heb' ix sjulek' jichan sb'a t'a skal k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh, ix yak'anoch pichul heb' yik kusk'olal.

Ha heb' ix ix tz'ak'an serwil ix reina Ester yet' heb' winh winak stanhwan ix, ix yal heb' yab' ix tas yaj winhaj Mardoqueo chi', yuj chi' ix te kus sk'ol ix, ix yak'anb'at pichul ix t'a winh yik syik'anel pichul yik kusk'olal ayoch chi' yuj winh, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix scha'a.

Haxo ix Ester chi' ix awtankot jun winh schekab' winh rey skuch Hatac, schekab' pax winh ix. Ix schekanb'at winh ix t'a winhaj Mardoqueo yik b'at sk'anb'ej winh tas wan yuji, tas pax yuj icha chi' syutej sb'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'och winhaj Hatac chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Mardoqueo chi' t'a jun parque t'a yichanh sti' spalacio winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Mardoqueo masanil tastak tz'alchaj chi' t'ay yet' pax jantak sb'isul k'e'en plata syaltej winhaj Amán yik tz'och b'aj smolchaj k'e'en stumin winh rey yik wach' satji'el masanil heb' israel yalan winh.

Ix yak'anpax jun scopia'il jun ley chi' winh t'a winhaj Hatac chi', yik sch'ox winh t'a ix Ester chi' yik syojtakejel ix yuj tas wan yuji t'a chonhab' Susa chi'. Ix yalanpaxb'at winhaj Mardoqueo chi' to stewi ix t'a winh rey, tope wal syal yek'b'at jun ley chi' t'a yib'anh heb' yetchonhab' ix chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta winhaj Hatac chi', ix ul yalan winh t'a ix Ester chi' masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.
Ix schekanxib'at winhaj Hatac chi' ix yik b'at yalxi winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik:

Masanil mach ayoch schekab'ok winh rey yet' masanil chonhab' ayoch t'a yol smakb'en winh, yojtak heb' to ay jun ley tz'alani tato ay mach tz'och t'a yol sti' b'aj ay winh rey t'a spalacio, tato manh awtab'ilok yuj winh rey chi', b'enhej schami, taxonhej winak ma ix. Anhej b'i'an tato syik'k'e sk'okoch winh rey chi', haton jun nab'a oro, sch'oxanelta winh t'ay, a jun chi' max chamlaj. Ha in tik, ayxo jun ujal max in awtaj yuj winh rey chi', xchib'at ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Hatac t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix Ester chi'.
Yuj chi' ix spakanxi winh tas ix yal ix chi': Manh a nalaj to yujnhej to ayach ek' t'a spalacio winh rey chi' ol ach kolchajok yakb'an masanil heb' ketchonhab' ol cham heb'.

Tope yuj jun sjawi t'a kib'anh tik jun, yuj chi' ix ach sik'chajoch reina'il, yik tzonh a kolani. Palta tato malaj tas ol al tikne'ik, b'ajam ol kot junok mach ol onh kolanok, palta a ach tik ol ach satel yet' masanil heb' a k'ab'ok, xchib'at winh.
Ix yalanxib'at ix Ester chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ixik, molb'ej masanil heb' ketchonhab' kajan t'a chonhab' Susa tik, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal wu'uj, malaj jab'ok tas tze wa'a, malaj pax tas tzeyuk'ej oxe'ok k'uhal oxe'ok ak'wal. Ol och pax heb' ix tzin ak'an serwil t'a tzek'ojk'olal wet'ok. Ol lajwok chi', ol in b'at wil winh rey chi', wach'chom manh ichokta' yalan ley. Taxonhej tzin cham jun, chamok in okab'i, xchib'at ix.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Mardoqueo chi' masanil tas ix yal ix chi'.
